dict.string:
on alfred_script(q) set wasRunning to application "Ghostty" is running tell application "Ghostty" activate set cfg to new surface configuration
if not wasRunning then repeat 20 times if (count of windows) is greater than 0 then exit repeat delay 0.05 end repeat end if
if (count of windows) is 0 then set win to new window with configuration cfg set term to focused terminal of selected tab of win else if not wasRunning then set term to focused terminal of selected tab of front window else set t to new tab in front window with configuration cfg set term to focused terminal of t end if
if q is not "" then input text q to term send key "enter" to term end if end tell end alfred_script
